analysis.title: American Tower Corp. (AMT): 3Q26 First Take: EBITDA beat and reiterate; repurchase activity increasing
key_insights: GS expects AMT stock to be mixed. An EBITDA beat and higher buyback activity are offset by largely reiterated 2026E guidance and softer US organic growth.
3Q26 adjusted EBITDA of $1.83 bn and total revenue of $2.79 bn both beat GSe and consensus. Beats came from LatAm, Africa/APAC and data center, offset by misses in Europe and Services.
US organic tenant billings growth was +0.0% against GSe +0.4% and consensus +0.5%. The 2026E US organic tenant billings growth guide of +0.5% was reiterated.
AFFO/share of $2.87 missed GSe of $2.89 but beat Visible Alpha consensus of $2.79.
AMT repurchased $315 mn of stock in the quarter and announced a new $2.0 bn share repurchase authorization.
AMT agreed to sell its Canada business for CA$288 mn (about $202 mn USD), expected to close in 4Q26. The segment had 226 towers as of Dec-25 and $12 mn of operating revenue in 2025.
2026 adjusted EBITDA and absolute AFFO guidance midpoints are unchanged, with narrower ranges. AFFO/share guidance rose at the midpoint on a lower share count.

Property revenue guidance was raised at the midpoint, driven mainly by data center outperformance and international. The report text says the raise is $55 bn, but the stated ranges imply about $55 mn.
International organic tenant billings growth beat in LatAm (-2.1% vs GSe -3.1%) and Africa/APAC (8.2% vs GSe 6.7%). Europe was 4.2%, above GSe but below consensus of 5.2%.
GS reiterates a Buy rating and a $210 12-month target price on AMT, based on 17x NTM+1Y Price/AFFO.

market_movers.rationale: Target is based on 17x NTM+1Y Price/AFFO, unchanged from the 28-Jul-26 target. The stock closed at $188.28 on 26 Oct, implying 11.5% upside.

earnings_insights: AMT 3Q26 reported AFFO attributable to common per diluted share of $2.87 vs GSe $2.89 and Visible Alpha consensus $2.79 (reported 10/27), +3.2% y/y.
AMT 3Q26 reported adjusted EBITDA of $1.832 bn vs GSe $1.821 bn and consensus $1.819 bn, +0.9% y/y (reported 10/27).
AMT 3Q26 reported total operating revenue (GAAP) of $2.785 bn vs GSe $2.760 bn and consensus $2.759 bn, +2.5% y/y. Total property revenue was $2.734 bn vs GSe $2.700 bn, +4.5% y/y.
Consolidated AFFO was $1.335 bn reported vs GSe $1.346 bn, a 1% miss, but above consensus of $1.301 bn.
Domestic property revenue (GAAP) of $1.275 bn was in line with GSe and consensus ($1.275 bn / $1.276 bn), -3.3% y/y. Domestic organic tenant billings growth was 0.0% vs GSe 0.4% and consensus 0.5%.
LatAm property revenue of $460 mn vs GSe $443 mn and consensus $440 mn, +10.4% y/y. Africa/APAC property revenue of $428 mn vs GSe $418 mn and consensus $409 mn, +15.4% y/y.
Europe property revenue of $258 mn vs GSe $256 mn but below consensus of $261 mn. Data center property revenue of $313 mn vs GSe $307 mn and consensus $305 mn, up from $267 mn in 3Q25.
Company 2026 guidance (updated 10/27): property revenue $10.785-10.865 bn (prior $10.695-10.845 bn), domestic property revenue $5.085-5.095 bn, international property revenue $4.482-4.542 bn.
Company 2026 guidance: adjusted EBITDA $7.248-7.303 bn (midpoint unchanged), AFFO $5.148-5.203 bn (midpoint unchanged), AFFO/share $11.04-11.16 (prior $11.00-11.17).
GS 2026E estimates: revenue $11,024 mn, EBITDA $7,274 mn, EPS $6.92, P/E 27.2x, EV/EBITDA 17.8x, net debt/EBITDA 4.9x.
risk_factors: Ongoing pressure in core US tower leasing if wireless carriers keep constraining spending plans.
Global macro pressure could drive further carrier consolidation across AMT's international markets, pressuring revenue and AFFO growth.
Elevated interest rates could lower multiples for highly levered REIT equities.
FX swings in emerging market currencies could affect revenue and AFFO.
